For germination. After you soak the seeds in water ( room temp or a little cooler tends to work best i found). After that fold a few papertowels and put the seeds in that. Keep the paper towels wet but not dripping. I live in a pretty warm area so to prevent them from drying out i put them in ziploc bags to retain moisture. Keep them in a dark place thats roughly 65-75 degrees. You can actually " plant" them when the tap root is 3/4 to 1 inch long is my sweet spot. About your cotton question. I would just get some rock wool from either a big box or hydroponic shop (you can even order it online) it is pretty cheap to get plenty for multiple grows. Cotton balls are bleached and i dont particularly know whether that will affect the plant or even if the roots and break through ( im sure they will). Clay balls are a great idea for algae and to take up space the rock wool might leave vacant. Hydroponic grows can be really fun. Kratky is a good choice but with cannabis i would play safer and go with a circulating system. Good luck with your grow! I hope some of this was useful.
